notes: Guest archetypes for social events (director note D2) and the traits guests carry. classes/regions/fears/traits are relative weights. fears use threat track ids from src/world/tracks.js (Classic or alternate); a fear whose track is not in this campaign's world falls to the track running in the same slot. Personality traits shape dialogue (likes/dislikes are conversation approaches); client traits come from the GDD Clients section and matter once a guest becomes a client. hidden traits are only revealed in conversation.

traits.name: Vain
traits.blurb: Wants to be told the bunker will be the envy of everyone they know.

traits.name: Paranoid
traits.blurb: Already knows the end is coming and wants proof you do too. As a client: inspects the Survive tier, demands more Days Sealed, signs off slowly.

traits.name: Skeptical
traits.blurb: Has heard every pitch. Rolls their eyes at doom.

traits.name: Generous
traits.blurb: Wants a bunker with room for the people they love, and a plaque saying so.

traits.name: Gossipy
traits.blurb: Will tell the whole room what you said, for better or worse.

traits.name: Impatient
traits.blurb: Gives you about ninety seconds.

traits.name: Competitive
traits.blurb: Only wants it if a rival already has one.

traits.name: Sentimental
traits.blurb: Thinks about the grandchildren, and the family silver.

traits.name: Engineer
traits.blurb: Inspects everything and tells peers about flaws.

traits.name: Germaphobe
traits.blurb: Needs Decon and a Med Bay; fears The Bloom twice as much.

traits.name: Gourmand
traits.blurb: Wants a Chef's Kitchen and Wine Cellar; eats 1.5x the food.

traits.name: Pet Parent
traits.blurb: Pet decor, later a Pet Clone Lab. Animals count as extra mouths.

traits.name: Influencer
traits.blurb: Wants a Broadcast Studio; doubles referral leads. Leaks unless under NDA.

traits.name: Collector
traits.blurb: Wants an Art Vault and a Museum of Me.

traits.name: Dynast
traits.blurb: Wants an Heir Nursery; +2 occupants per generation.

traits.name: Health Optimizer
traits.blurb: Biohacking Lab, then Cryo Pods. Always wants the newest unlock.

traits.name: Control Freak
traits.blurb: Demands override codes to every system. Leverage +10 at handover.

traits.name: Penny-Pincher
traits.blurb: Haggles 15% off. Pays late.

traits.name: Secretly Broke
traits.blurb: May default on retainers. You hold leverage over them, for once.

traits.name: Knows Too Much
traits.blurb: Starts with 30 leverage over you. Blackmail arrives early.

archetypes.title: The Prepping Dentist
archetypes.blurb: Twelve years of canned peaches in the garage. Now wants a real hole in the ground.

archetypes.title: The Lottery Winner
archetypes.blurb: Won big, told everyone, and now everyone knows where they live.

archetypes.title: The Celebrity Chef
archetypes.blurb: Will not survive the end of the world without a proper walk-in fridge.

archetypes.title: The Wellness Influencer
archetypes.blurb: Two million followers and a cold-plunge sponsorship. Wants a bunker that photographs well.

archetypes.title: The Crypto Founder
archetypes.blurb: Paper billionaire, real anxieties. Asks whether you take tokens.

archetypes.title: The Reformed AI Engineer
archetypes.blurb: Helped build the thing they now lie awake about. Wants everything wired, nothing smart.

archetypes.title: The Hedge Fund Doomer
archetypes.blurb: Shorted everything except the apocalypse. Now long on concrete.

archetypes.title: The Agribusiness Baron
archetypes.blurb: Owns more land than some countries and is quietly worried about the bees.

archetypes.title: The Defence Contractor
archetypes.blurb: Sells to both sides of the border, and has a professional opinion on blast doors.

archetypes.title: The Old-Money Dowager
archetypes.blurb: The family survived three revolutions by being somewhere else. Intends to keep the tradition.

archetypes.title: The Shipping Heir
archetypes.blurb: Grew up on yachts and has never been further than a helicopter from a cocktail.

archetypes.title: The Media Mogul
archetypes.blurb: Sells the headlines that sell your bunkers. Expects a friends-and-family rate.

archetypes.title: The Energy Magnate
archetypes.blurb: Made a fortune heating the planet and wants a fortress that stays cool.

archetypes.title: The Orbital Tourist
archetypes.blurb: Has seen the planet from above and found it a bit much. Wants a bunker with a view anyway.

archetypes.title: The Table Envoy
archetypes.blurb: Speaks for people who do not attend parties. Asks very few questions, all of them uncomfortable.
